messages:
maya: Customer reporting free-trial blocked by fraud checks. Account: acct_01GZx9, email user+promo@mailinator.com, billing country US, reported IP 45.77.12.3 (appears cloud/VPS), card BIN 400555 (US), device_fingerprint dfp_9a7b3f. Customer says they're a small SaaS startup — asking for trial to evaluate Redwood. Attached screenshot of error: "trial_onhold: risk_score=82"

ryan: Can you paste the admin URL and the specific flags from the risk panel? Also any customer-provided proof (company website, LinkedIn)?

maya: Admin link: https://console.redwood.dev/admin/accounts/acct_01GZx9 — risk panel shows: disposable_email, vpn_proxy, card_bin_mismatch, device_fp_rotation. Customer provided company website (example-sa as github repo) and a photo ID claim but hasn't uploaded proof here yet.

fraud-bot: Automated flags for acct_01GZx9: [disposable_email, vpn_proxy, card_bin_mismatch, device_fp_rotation]. Recent matches: dfp_9a7b3f seen on 3 accounts in last 48h. IP 45.77.12.3 ASN: DigitalOcean (possible cloud VM). Risk score breakdown: email=35, ip=20, card=15, device_fp=12. Total=82.

olivia: Thanks — likely high-risk. Two questions: 1) can the customer do phone verification (SMS) and upload company incorporation docs or gov ID? 2) Are they requesting an immediate override or just asking why blocked? If they can provide phone + ID we can consider manual 7-day trial.

maya: They want to get started today. Said they can do phone verification + sent a selfie + government ID via secure upload link (I gave them secure upload). Also asked if we can do a temporary 3-day trial while fraud ops reviews.

sam: From fraud ops — we generally avoid auto-grant for disposable email + cloud IP + repeated device_fp. But if they provide selfie + ID and phone verification we can do a controlled manual grant. Procedure: create a case in Fraud Ops, attach evidence, set account tag "manual_trial_under_review", grant trial for 3 days with token cap 50k, and monitor for abnormal token patterns and sudden spike in model usage. If usage looks suspicious, revoke immediately and start chargeback review flow.

kevin: Technically we can perform the override via admin API. Example request (admin only):
```
POST https://console.redwood.dev/admin/api/accounts/acct_01GZx9/override
{
  "action": "grant_trial",
  "duration_days": 3,
  "note": "manual override after ID+phone verified — fraud ops case #FO-2026",
  "token_cap": 50000
}
```
Make sure the request is logged and include the evidence link in the case. I'll add a short-term rule to alert on any embedding-heavy or re-ranking traffic spikes for that account.

olivia: I've created FO-2026 and attached the upload link content. Verified selfie matched ID (face match confidence 0.92) and SMS verification succeeded (+1). Approving a 3-day supervised trial with token cap 50k. We'll monitor and revert if suspicious. :white_check_mark:

maya: Thanks all — performing the admin override now and adding note to FO-2026. I will message the customer to confirm 3-day trial granted and that we will follow up after review. :raised_hands:

fraud-bot: Action logged: admin_override by maya (grant_trial, duration=3d, token_cap=50000) — linked to FO-2026. Risk ops will monitor for 72h.

maya: Closing loop with customer now. If any anomalies show up, please ping #incidents and tag fraud-ops.
